plan.title: Closed RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Window

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Match the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Match the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Match the required evaluation-reopen permission configuration.
Open the RFQ Settings action that should display the evaluation-time window.
Verify the expected window title is visible.
Verify the duration-editing option is present.
Verify the ending-time option is present.
Verify the dialog provides a Cancel button.
Verify the dialog provides an Ok button.
